title: 3. Behavior and Segments — Offline
description: First-day behavior and selected cohorts; no causal driver or model explanation is claimed.

list.name: platform
list.label: Platform
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(platform, '') AS __text, COALESCE(platform, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(country, '') AS __text, COALESCE(country, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(acquisition_channel, '') AS __text, COALESCE(acquisition_channel, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: goal
list.label: Goal
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(onboarding_goal, '') AS __text, COALESCE(onboarding_goal, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: flow
list.label: Flow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(flow, '') AS __text, COALESCE(flow, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: test
list.label: Test
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ab_test, '') AS __text, COALESCE(ab_test, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

panels.title: First-day edits by onboarding goal
panels.description: Association, not a cause of churn.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.onboarding_goal AS "Goal", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users", ROUND(AVG(u.ai_edits_first_day),2)::double precision AS "Mean first-day edits" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT u.push_opt_in AS "Push opt-in", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users", ROUND(AVG(u.photos_imported),2)::double precision AS "Mean photos imported" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: First-day edit bands by channel
panels.description: Group size shown; bands are descriptive, not model thresholds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.acquisition_channel AS "Channel", CASE WHEN u.ai_edits_first_day=0 THEN '0' WHEN u.ai_edits_first_day<4 THEN '1-3' WHEN u.ai_edits_first_day<8 THEN '4-7' ELSE '8+' END AS "First-day edits", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Cohort composition by platform and country
panels.description: No feature importance or SHAP until the external owner supplies explanations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.platform AS "Platform", u.country AS "Country", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
